errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва числовите стойности и е означена с „лв.“
errors.evidence: The vertical axis is labeled as '%', not 'лв.' as stated in the machine-generated description.
The highest value in the chart exceeds 120,000 but does not reach 125,000–130,000 as stated.
The lowest values are 80,000, not 80,000–85,000 as stated.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates percentage values for three years (2022, 2023, 2024) across months.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the vertical axis represents percentage values ('%').
The machine-generated description does not highlight that the highest value is in December 2022, exceeding 120,000, and the lowest value is in December and July 2023, at 80,000.
The machine-generated description does not mention that 2024 generally has the highest values across months.
